Definition: of uncertain origin; Cos, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cos.
BiblicalUsage: Cos is an island in the Mediterranean, a stop on Paul's voyage to Jerusalem. Acts 21:1 says the ship came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Cos is one more island on the road to Jerusalem: the voyage runs straight, and Paul does not turn back.
